Messages.Author: Anatol Sendker
Messages.Body:
1. Can a "Scorn of Adonis" be played once the referendum is being held and
there have been votes cast against it (since you cannot change them once
they're cast) and those Methuselahs will therefore lose a pool?

2. Picture this: Anson is at 4 blood and calls a referendum which passes by
10 votes. Then he plays "Voter Captivation". How does this work:
a. Anson gets 4 blood. Then up to 2 of _that_ blood go to the pool of the
Methuselah, i.e. Anson loses it (Anson was at 8, Methuselah takes 2 of that
8 to his pool and Anson is at 6)?
b. Anson gets 4 blood and is at full capacity 8 _and_ Methuselah gets 2 pool
directly from the blood bank?

Thanks for your help,
Anatol.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Anatol Sendker wrote:
>
> 1. Can a "Scorn of Adonis" be played once the referendum is being held and
> there have been votes cast against it (since you cannot change them once
> they're cast) and those Methuselahs will therefore lose a pool?

Yes.

> 2. Picture this: Anson is at 4 blood and calls a referendum which passes by
> 10 votes. Then he plays "Voter Captivation". How does this work:
> a. Anson gets 4 blood. Then up to 2 of _that_ blood go to the pool of the
> Methuselah, i.e. Anson loses it (Anson was at 8, Methuselah takes 2 of that
> 8 to his pool and Anson is at 6)?
> b. Anson gets 4 blood and is at full capacity 8 _and_ Methuselah gets 2 pool
> directly from the blood bank?

c. 10 counters are retrieved from the blood bank. You elect to put two of
them in your pool and the rest (eight) on Anson. The blood in excess of
his capacity drains off.

Messages.Author: Pepijn Kok
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 20 Sep 2002 12:21:33 GMT, "Anatol Sendker" <ana...@fangg.com>
wrote:

>1. Can a "Scorn of Adonis" be played once the referendum is being held and
>there have been votes cast against it (since you cannot change them once
>they're cast) and those Methuselahs will therefore lose a pool?

It must be during a referendum, so can also be before it resolves. So
yes it can be used after votes are placed, and before the political
action is resolved.

>2. Picture this: Anson is at 4 blood and calls a referendum which passes by
>10 votes. Then he plays "Voter Captivation". How does this work:
>a. Anson gets 4 blood. Then up to 2 of _that_ blood go to the pool of the
>Methuselah, i.e. Anson loses it (Anson was at 8, Methuselah takes 2 of that
>8 to his pool and Anson is at 6)?
>b. Anson gets 4 blood and is at full capacity 8 _and_ Methuselah gets 2 pool
>directly from the blood bank?

B. He has the potential to gain 10 blood, 2 of which go to you 6 of
which go to anson. 2 drain off since he's already full.
